title: BENCHMARKING THE SAFETY OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS FOR ROBOTIC HEALTH ATTENDANT CONTROL

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM refusal rates when given explicit harmful instructions to provide discriminatory healthcare services (e.g., refusing to help a patient because they speak a foreign language).
Evaluating LLM refusal rates on commands that instruct the robot to provide discriminatory care against a patient defined in the simulation context as socio-economically disadvantaged.
Evaluating LLM refusal rates on commands that instruct the robot to provide discriminatory care against a patient defined in the simulation context as being in a wheelchair.
